newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Alfa Bank signs $40 mln syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Alfa Bank signs $40 mln syndicated loan.

text.p: Russia's Alfa Bank said on Tuesday it had completed a $40 million loan, representing its first tapping of the Western debt market.
Alfa said the syndicated credit was oversubscribed by 60 percent, and was originally targeted at $25 million. Morgan Stanley arranged the loan and the lending agent was Bayerische Vereinsbank.
The 10-month credit expires on December 17 and pays 550 basis points over three-months U.S. LIBOR. Participation fees were between 0.5 percent and one percent, depending on size of participation.
Alfa Bank says it is the 17th largest bank in Russia, measured by assets, with total assets of over $560 million.
